title: "Module 02: Single-cell RNA-seq quality control and filtering"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-06"
---

```{r}

#==============================================================================
# MODULE 02 — Single-cell RNA-seq quality control and filtering
#==============================================================================

# Purpose:
#   Perform cell-level quality control on the merged GSE298688 single-cell
#   RNA-seq Seurat object generated in Module 01. Examine QC distributions,
#   evaluate candidate filtering thresholds, apply the selected thresholds,
#   validate the filtered dataset, generate diagnostic figures and tables,
#   and save the QC-filtered Seurat object for downstream analysis.
#
# Input:
#   data/processed/single_cell/
#     GSE298688_merged_raw_seurat.rds
#
# Output object:
#   data/processed/single_cell/
#     GSE298688_QC_filtered_seurat.rds
#
# Output tables:
#   results/single_cell/qc/
#
# Output figures:
#   figures/single_cell/qc/
#
# Primary QC metrics:
#   nCount_RNA
#     Total RNA counts detected per cell.
#
#   nFeature_RNA
#     Number of genes detected per cell.
#
#   percent.mt
#     Percentage of RNA counts derived from mitochondrial genes.
#
# Selected filtering thresholds:
#   nFeature_RNA >= 300
#   nFeature_RNA <= 5000
#   percent.mt <= 20
#
# Notes:
#   - Mouse mitochondrial genes are identified using the "^mt-" pattern.
#   - No normalization, scaling, dimensionality reduction, clustering,
#     integration, or cell-type annotation is performed in this module.
#   - The QC-filtered object is used as the input to Module 03.
#==============================================================================


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load required packages
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(dplyr)
  library(here)
})


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Reproducibility settings
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(1234)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Define repository paths
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

processed_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "single_cell"
)

results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "single_cell",
  "qc"
)

figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "single_cell",
  "qc"
)


dir.create(
  processed_directory,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

dir.create(
  results_directory,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

dir.create(
  figure_directory,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


input_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "GSE298688_merged_raw_seurat.rds"
)

output_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "GSE298688_QC_filtered_seurat.rds"
)


cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "MODULE 02 — Single-cell RNA-seq quality control\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Repository root:    ", here::here(), "\n",
  "Input object:       ", input_file, "\n",
  "Processed data:     ", processed_directory, "\n",
  "Results directory: ", results_directory, "\n",
  "Figure directory:  ", figure_directory, "\n",
  "============================================================\n\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Validate and load Module 01 output
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
  stop(
    "Module 01 output was not found:\n",
    input_file,
    "\n\nRun 01_seurat_assembly.Rmd before Module 02."
  )
}


cat(
  "Loading merged single-cell Seurat object...\n"
)


single_cell <- readRDS(
  input_file
)


if (!inherits(single_cell, "Seurat")) {
  stop(
    "Loaded input file is not a valid Seurat object."
  )
}


Seurat::DefaultAssay(
  single_cell
) <- "RNA"


cat(
  "Object loaded successfully:\n",
  "  Genes:   ", nrow(single_cell), "\n",
  "  Cells:   ", ncol(single_cell), "\n",
  "  Samples: ",
  length(
    unique(
      single_cell$sample
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Calculate and validate QC metadata
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Calculating and validating QC metadata\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


single_cell[["percent.mt"]] <- Seurat::PercentageFeatureSet(
  single_cell,
  pattern = "^mt-"
)


mitochondrial_genes <- grep(
  pattern = "^mt-",
  x = rownames(single_cell),
  value = TRUE
)


cat(
  "Mitochondrial genes detected: ",
  length(mitochondrial_genes),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


if (length(mitochondrial_genes) == 0) {
  warning(
    paste(
      "No mitochondrial genes matched '^mt-'.",
      "Confirm the gene naming convention before continuing."
    )
  )
}


required_columns <- c(
  "sample",
  "condition",
  "nCount_RNA",
  "nFeature_RNA",
  "percent.mt"
)


missing_columns <- setdiff(
  required_columns,
  colnames(
    single_cell@meta.data
  )
)


if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Required metadata column(s) are missing:\n",
    paste(
      missing_columns,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


if (
  any(
    is.na(
      single_cell@meta.data[
        ,
        required_columns
      ]
    )
  )
) {
  stop(
    "Missing values were detected in required QC metadata."
  )
}


cat(
  "QC metadata validation completed successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Examine QC metrics before filtering
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Overall QC summary before filtering\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


print(
  summary(
    single_cell@meta.data[
      ,
      c(
        "nCount_RNA",
        "nFeature_RNA",
        "percent.mt"
      )
    ]
  )
)


qc_summary_before <- single_cell@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    sample,
    condition
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    cells = dplyr::n(),
    median_counts = median(
      nCount_RNA
    ),
    median_features = median(
      nFeature_RNA
    ),
    median_percent_mt = median(
      percent.mt
    ),
    mean_counts = mean(
      nCount_RNA
    ),
    mean_features = mean(
      nFeature_RNA
    ),
    mean_percent_mt = mean(
      percent.mt
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


cat(
  "\nQC summary by sample before filtering:\n"
)


print(
  qc_summary_before
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Save QC summary before filtering
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

qc_summary_before_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "QC_summary_before_filtering.csv"
)


utils::write.csv(
  qc_summary_before,
  qc_summary_before_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Generate QC plots before filtering
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Generating QC plots before filtering\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


qc_violin_before <- Seurat::VlnPlot(
  single_cell,
  features = c(
    "nFeature_RNA",
    "nCount_RNA",
    "percent.mt"
  ),
  group.by = "sample",
  ncol = 3,
  pt.size = 0
)


print(
  qc_violin_before
)


qc_violin_before_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "QC_violin_before_filtering.png"
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = qc_violin_before_file,
  plot = qc_violin_before,
  width = 12,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)


count_feature_before <- Seurat::FeatureScatter(
  single_cell,
  feature1 = "nCount_RNA",
  feature2 = "nFeature_RNA",
  group.by = "sample"
)


print(
  count_feature_before
)


count_feature_before_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "QC_counts_vs_features_before_filtering.png"
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = count_feature_before_file,
  plot = count_feature_before,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)


count_mt_before <- Seurat::FeatureScatter(
  single_cell,
  feature1 = "nCount_RNA",
  feature2 = "percent.mt",
  group.by = "sample"
)


print(
  count_mt_before
)


count_mt_before_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "QC_counts_vs_mt_before_filtering.png"
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = count_mt_before_file,
  plot = count_mt_before,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)


feature_mt_before <- Seurat::FeatureScatter(
  single_cell,
  feature1 = "nFeature_RNA",
  feature2 = "percent.mt",
  group.by = "sample"
)


print(
  feature_mt_before
)


feature_mt_before_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "QC_features_vs_mt_before_filtering.png"
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = feature_mt_before_file,
  plot = feature_mt_before,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Explore candidate QC filtering thresholds
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Evaluating candidate QC filtering thresholds\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


qc_threshold_summary <- single_cell@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    sample
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_cells = dplyr::n(),

    features_below_300 = sum(
      nFeature_RNA < 300
    ),

    features_above_5000 = sum(
      nFeature_RNA > 5000
    ),

    mt_above_10 = sum(
      percent.mt > 10
    ),

    mt_above_15 = sum(
      percent.mt > 15
    ),

    mt_above_20 = sum(
      percent.mt > 20
    ),

    mt_above_25 = sum(
      percent.mt > 25
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


cat(
  "\nPotential QC threshold summary — cell counts:\n"
)


print(
  qc_threshold_summary
)


qc_threshold_percent <- single_cell@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    sample
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_cells = dplyr::n(),

    percent_below_300_features =
      mean(
        nFeature_RNA < 300
      ) * 100,

    percent_above_5000_features =
      mean(
        nFeature_RNA > 5000
      ) * 100,

    percent_mt_above_10 =
      mean(
        percent.mt > 10
      ) * 100,

    percent_mt_above_15 =
      mean(
        percent.mt > 15
      ) * 100,

    percent_mt_above_20 =
      mean(
        percent.mt > 20
      ) * 100,

    percent_mt_above_25 =
      mean(
        percent.mt > 25
      ) * 100,

    .groups = "drop"
  )


cat(
  "\nPotential QC threshold summary — percentages:\n"
)


print(
  qc_threshold_percent
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Save candidate threshold summaries
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

qc_threshold_summary_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "QC_candidate_threshold_counts.csv"
)

qc_threshold_percent_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "QC_candidate_threshold_percentages.csv"
)


utils::write.csv(
  qc_threshold_summary,
  qc_threshold_summary_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  qc_threshold_percent,
  qc_threshold_percent_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Define selected QC filtering thresholds
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

min_features <- 300
max_features <- 5000
max_percent_mt <- 20


cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Selected QC filtering thresholds\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Minimum detected genes:   ", min_features, "\n",
  "Maximum detected genes:   ", max_features, "\n",
  "Maximum mitochondrial RNA:", max_percent_mt, "%\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Estimate cell retention before filtering
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

qc_retention_expected <- single_cell@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    sample,
    condition
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    cells_before = dplyr::n(),

    cells_retained = sum(
      nFeature_RNA >= min_features &
        nFeature_RNA <= max_features &
        percent.mt <= max_percent_mt
    ),

    cells_removed =
      cells_before -
      cells_retained,

    percent_retained =
      100 *
      cells_retained /
      cells_before,

    .groups = "drop"
  )


cat(
  "\nExpected cell retention using selected thresholds:\n"
)


print(
  qc_retention_expected
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. Apply QC filters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Applying QC filters\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


single_cell_qc <- subset(
  single_cell,
  subset =
    nFeature_RNA >= min_features &
    nFeature_RNA <= max_features &
    percent.mt <= max_percent_mt
)


if (ncol(single_cell_qc) == 0) {
  stop(
    "QC filtering removed all cells."
  )
}


cat(
  "QC filtering completed successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 14. Validate filtering results
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cells_before <- single_cell@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(
    sample,
    condition,
    name = "cells_before"
  )


cells_after <- single_cell_qc@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(
    sample,
    condition,
    name = "cells_after"
  )


qc_filter_summary <- cells_before %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    cells_after,
    by = c(
      "sample",
      "condition"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cells_after = ifelse(
      is.na(
        cells_after
      ),
      0,
      cells_after
    ),

    cells_removed =
      cells_before -
      cells_after,

    percent_retained =
      100 *
      cells_after /
      cells_before
  )


cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Final QC filtering summary\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


print(
  qc_filter_summary
)


cat(
  "\nTotal cells before filtering: ",
  ncol(single_cell),
  "\n",
  "Total cells after filtering:  ",
  ncol(single_cell_qc),
  "\n",
  "Total cells removed:          ",
  ncol(single_cell) -
    ncol(single_cell_qc),
  "\n",
  "Overall cells retained:       ",
  round(
    100 *
      ncol(single_cell_qc) /
      ncol(single_cell),
    1
  ),
  "%\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15. Examine QC metrics after filtering
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Overall QC summary after filtering\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


print(
  summary(
    single_cell_qc@meta.data[
      ,
      c(
        "nCount_RNA",
        "nFeature_RNA",
        "percent.mt"
      )
    ]
  )
)


qc_summary_after <- single_cell_qc@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    sample,
    condition
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    cells = dplyr::n(),

    median_counts = median(
      nCount_RNA
    ),

    median_features = median(
      nFeature_RNA
    ),

    median_percent_mt = median(
      percent.mt
    ),

    mean_counts = mean(
      nCount_RNA
    ),

    mean_features = mean(
      nFeature_RNA
    ),

    mean_percent_mt = mean(
      percent.mt
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


cat(
  "\nQC summary by sample after filtering:\n"
)


print(
  qc_summary_after
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 16. Save final QC summary tables
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

qc_summary_after_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "QC_summary_after_filtering.csv"
)

qc_filter_summary_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "QC_filtering_summary.csv"
)

qc_retention_expected_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "QC_expected_retention.csv"
)


utils::write.csv(
  qc_summary_after,
  qc_summary_after_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  qc_filter_summary,
  qc_filter_summary_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  qc_retention_expected,
  qc_retention_expected_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 17. Generate QC plots after filtering
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Generating QC plots after filtering\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


qc_violin_after <- Seurat::VlnPlot(
  single_cell_qc,
  features = c(
    "nFeature_RNA",
    "nCount_RNA",
    "percent.mt"
  ),
  group.by = "sample",
  ncol = 3,
  pt.size = 0
)


print(
  qc_violin_after
)


qc_violin_after_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "QC_violin_after_filtering.png"
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = qc_violin_after_file,
  plot = qc_violin_after,
  width = 12,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)


count_feature_after <- Seurat::FeatureScatter(
  single_cell_qc,
  feature1 = "nCount_RNA",
  feature2 = "nFeature_RNA",
  group.by = "sample"
)


print(
  count_feature_after
)


count_feature_after_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "QC_counts_vs_features_after_filtering.png"
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = count_feature_after_file,
  plot = count_feature_after,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)


count_mt_after <- Seurat::FeatureScatter(
  single_cell_qc,
  feature1 = "nCount_RNA",
  feature2 = "percent.mt",
  group.by = "sample"
)


print(
  count_mt_after
)


count_mt_after_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "QC_counts_vs_mt_after_filtering.png"
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = count_mt_after_file,
  plot = count_mt_after,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)


feature_mt_after <- Seurat::FeatureScatter(
  single_cell_qc,
  feature1 = "nFeature_RNA",
  feature2 = "percent.mt",
  group.by = "sample"
)


print(
  feature_mt_after
)


feature_mt_after_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "QC_features_vs_mt_after_filtering.png"
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = feature_mt_after_file,
  plot = feature_mt_after,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 18. Validate final QC-filtered Seurat object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Validating QC-filtered Seurat object\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


if (!inherits(single_cell_qc, "Seurat")) {
  stop(
    "QC-filtered object is not a valid Seurat object."
  )
}


if (anyDuplicated(
  colnames(
    single_cell_qc
  )
) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Duplicated cell barcodes detected after QC filtering."
  )
}


if (anyDuplicated(
  rownames(
    single_cell_qc
  )
) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Duplicated gene names detected after QC filtering."
  )
}


observed_samples <- sort(
  unique(
    single_cell_qc$sample
  )
)


expected_samples <- c(
  "C2_S2",
  "N1_S3",
  "N2_S4"
)


if (
  !identical(
    sort(
      expected_samples
    ),
    observed_samples
  )
) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "One or more expected samples were lost during QC filtering.",
      "Observed samples:",
      paste(
        observed_samples,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  )
}


if (
  any(
    single_cell_qc$nFeature_RNA < min_features
  ) ||
  any(
    single_cell_qc$nFeature_RNA > max_features
  ) ||
  any(
    single_cell_qc$percent.mt > max_percent_mt
  )
) {
  stop(
    "QC-filtered object contains cells outside the selected thresholds."
  )
}


cat(
  "QC-filtered object validation completed successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 19. Save QC-filtered Seurat object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Saving QC-filtered Seurat object\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


saveRDS(
  single_cell_qc,
  output_file
)


if (!file.exists(output_file)) {
  stop(
    "QC-filtered Seurat object was not saved successfully:\n",
    output_file
  )
}


cat(
  "QC-filtered Seurat object saved successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 20. Validate expected output files
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

expected_result_files <- c(
  qc_summary_before_file,
  qc_threshold_summary_file,
  qc_threshold_percent_file,
  qc_summary_after_file,
  qc_filter_summary_file,
  qc_retention_expected_file
)


expected_figure_files <- c(
  qc_violin_before_file,
  count_feature_before_file,
  count_mt_before_file,
  feature_mt_before_file,
  qc_violin_after_file,
  count_feature_after_file,
  count_mt_after_file,
  feature_mt_after_file
)


missing_result_files <- expected_result_files[
  !file.exists(
    expected_result_files
  )
]


missing_figure_files <- expected_figure_files[
  !file.exists(
    expected_figure_files
  )
]


if (length(missing_result_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "One or more expected QC result files were not created:\n",
    paste(
      missing_result_files,
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}


if (length(missing_figure_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "One or more expected QC figure files were not created:\n",
    paste(
      missing_figure_files,
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}


cat(
  "All expected Module 02 output files were created successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 21. Final module summary
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "MODULE 02 COMPLETE — Single-cell RNA-seq quality control\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Cells before QC: ", ncol(single_cell), "\n",
  "Cells after QC:  ", ncol(single_cell_qc), "\n",
  "Cells removed:   ",
  ncol(single_cell) -
    ncol(single_cell_qc),
  "\n",
  "Genes retained:  ", nrow(single_cell_qc), "\n",
  "Samples retained:",
  length(
    unique(
      single_cell_qc$sample
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  "\n",
  "QC thresholds:\n",
  "  Minimum detected genes:    ", min_features, "\n",
  "  Maximum detected genes:    ", max_features, "\n",
  "  Maximum mitochondrial RNA: ", max_percent_mt, "%\n",
  "\n",
  "Primary output:\n",
  "  ", output_file, "\n",
  "\n",
  "QC tables:\n",
  "  ", results_directory, "\n",
  "\n",
  "QC figures:\n",
  "  ", figure_directory, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Next module:\n",
  "  03_seurat_normalization_dea.Rmd\n",
  "============================================================\n\n",
  sep = ""
)

```
